title: Supersession Is Not Retirement Or Erasure
summary: A map separating successor policy, supersession scope, transition, operational decommissioning, residual duties, remedy, independent confirmation, and permanent archive.
map_question: What obligations remain after an institution selects a successor policy or decides to end an existing one?
interpretation_boundary: A successor does not automatically terminate the prior authority, operation, contract, asset, data, service, remedy, or archive duty. Retirement does not permit deletion of evidence or unresolved harm.

nodes.label: Current authorized policy
nodes.note: No Phase 76 policy lifecycle has opened.

nodes.label: Effect, harm, challenge, and sunset review
nodes.note: Lifecycle evidence and unresolved duties are current.

nodes.label: Authorized successor and supersession scope
nodes.note: The exact provisions, users, systems, periods, and exceptions are named.

nodes.label: Transition and continuity plan
nodes.note: Users, accessibility, service, contracts, data, assets, workforce, and dependencies are protected.

nodes.label: Operational and technical decommissioning
nodes.note: Obsolete practice is removed from live systems, not only documents.

nodes.label: Residual duty and remedy ledger
nodes.note: Audit, privacy, security, compensation, restoration, and legal duties may survive.

nodes.label: Permanent discoverable archive
nodes.note: Evidence, rationale, dissent, failure, correction, and retirement receipts remain linked.

nodes.label: Independent retirement confirmation
nodes.note: No retirement or decommissioning receipt exists.

links.note: No authorized policy exists in Phase 76.
No successor or supersession decision exists.

what_this_map_supports: Fourteen policy-lifecycle gates and ten decommissioning obligations.
Visible separation among review, sunset, supersession, transition, retirement, decommissioning, residual duty, and archive.
Permanent discoverability of evidence, dissent, failures, harms, and receipts.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish a current policy, successor, supersession, sunset, retirement, decommissioning, remedy, or archive closure.
It does not cancel authority, contracts, licences, operations, data duties, services, liabilities, or unresolved harms.
It does not permit silent renewal, automatic retirement, archive deletion, scoring, or ranking.
next_records_needed: A real authorized policy and scheduled lifecycle review.
A successor authorization with exact supersession and transition scope.
Completed decommissioning obligations, residual-duty review, permanent archive, and independent public receipt.
